prompt.tooltip: Positive prompt (from the Design node). KIE limit: 20000 characters. Negative prompt: none: the model has no negative field, the Avoid list stays inside the prompt text.

aspect_ratio.tooltip: KIE allows: auto, 1:1, 3:2, 2:3, 4:3, 3:4, 5:4, 4:5, 16:9, 9:16, 2:1, 1:2, 3:1, 1:3, 21:9, 9:21. Offered: the Etsy formats this model supports.

resolution.tooltip: KIE sells: 1K, 2K, 4K. 2K is the minimum quality here. Output resolution: 1K, 2K or 4K. Set this field explicitly. 2K does not support 5:4, 4:5, 3:1, 1:3 or 9:21; 4K does not support 3:1, 1:3 or 9:21. The background parameter is only available at 1K.

dry_run.tooltip: ON (default): only checks the request and shows the LIVE price, nothing is sent and no credits are spent. OFF: pays KIE credits.

reference_labels.tooltip: ON: the long labels 'REFERENCE_IMAGE_1 / REFERENCE_IMAGE_2 ...' are put before the prompt (the app's full prompt needs them). OFF: the prompt itself says what image 1 and image 2 are (the brief prompt does).
